"The Price is Right™" has four of four top prizes left and is still new. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

If you play "The Price is Right™" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2774.headline: Early stage or late

2775.body:
"Casino 7s" has 355,763 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1,000 prize, with 28 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "Casino 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2775.headline: What's actually left to win

2776.body:
"Patriotic Payout" has eight of eight top prizes left and is early in its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Everything here about "Patriotic Payout" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through November 14.
2776.headline: Early stage or late

2779.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Gnome for the Holidays", most are still unsold. The game is early in its run, with 48 of 57 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "Gnome for the Holidays" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2779.headline: Early stage or late

2780.body:
The most common win left on "Holiday Countdown" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $1,000, and 50 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "Holiday Countdown" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2780.headline: What the prize table shows

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" offers a top prize of $250,000 and ten prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward small, frequent prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

The numbers for "The Perfect Gift" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2781.headline: The prize mix in this game

2782.body:
Only a small slice of the tickets for "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" have been sold. The game is near the start of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

If you play "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
